essence: Therefore, an oblation of blue rice brings peace to the temple.
Therefore, the accomplishment of grain will certainly come about.
Therefore, offerings of cakes destroy obstacles.
Therefore, hibiscus flowers bring control over the world and bana flowers bring enchantment.
Therefore, an oblation with ten-limbed incense produces incomparable good fortune.
